nodes.label: REQUIREMENT
nodes.tooltipDescription: T&E Users include Ministry of Defence (MOD) personnel from Front Line Commands, Defence Agencies, Defence Organisations, and approved defence contractors who have passed the required assurance checks by the Marketplace.

nodes.label: User Support Services
nodes.tooltipDescription: Provides T&E users and suppliers with a single integrated portal to access the market.

steps.tooltipDescription: Provides T&E users and suppliers with a single integrated portal to access the market.

nodes.label: T&E SERVICES
nodes.tooltipDescription: A combination of STEP-Funded T&E Services (Critical MOD owned or retained T&E capabilities, assets and services) and Other T&E Services (UK and international network of services, facilities and ranges available for T&E)

nodes.label: Provider Proposals
nodes.description: Provider proposals offered to T&E Demand
nodes.tooltipDescription: Once a service provider’s application is approved, they will gain access to the marketplace, where they can submit proposals to meet T&E requirements.
